owner: Authenticated manifest ID, injected by the framework

mt2.patches.add.effects: Register one mod-owned patch; stage during preparation

mt2.patches.remove.effects: Remove one patch belonging to the caller

mt2.patches.targets.effects: Read target discovery metadata; permitted during preparation

mt2.patches.status.effects: Read the published generation, order and unresolved references; permitted during preparation

id.description: Unique patch ID within the calling mod

callback_contract.before: Optional function receiving a copied target-specific Before record
callback_contract.after: Optional function receiving a copied target-specific After record
callback_contract.modify_before_return: nil or a partial replacement object supported by the target
callback_contract.world_write_calls: World-write APIs are rejected from all patch Before/After callbacks; modify callbacks return proposed values instead of issuing another write
callback_contract.copies: Editing a received table does not change native arguments, other observers or the original result

invocation.description: Exact invocation identity; never convert to a floating-point number

targets.summary: Observe the framework-owned native Update envelope
targets.thread: Bound game thread for Lua; native callbacks retain the typed native contract
targets.original: One unchanged native call; true original_returned means normal return only

targets.summary: Observe the framework-owned native object creation envelope
targets.thread: Lua observes bound-game-thread calls only; worker calls are not deferred into false Before/After pairs

result_available.description: Native result was non-null; no pointer or UID is exposed and no world action is confirmed

targets.original: One unchanged native call; result availability is not world-action confirmation

targets.summary: Mediate Framework time.set requests; does not intercept native clock/UI calls
targets.thread: Active Framework callback on the bound game thread

result.description: Stable MT2Clock readback after the adapter returned successfully

write_slots.ownership: One exclusive writer per target; conflicting registration rejects atomically

targets.authority: Only proven standalone permits execution. Unknown, Client and acknowledged Host deny; the shared Host-action bridge is unavailable in this version.

ordering.references: Fully qualified manifest-id:patch-id on the same target
ordering.after: Reverse order of entered callbacks in the same invocation snapshot
ordering.missing_references: Dormant and visible; not an implicit manifest dependency
ordering.cycle: Candidate rejected with a concrete cycle path; previous generation retained
ordering.languages: Lua and native registrations through this patch service share one order; existing legacy services retain their outer envelopes

status.patches: Published records with id, owner, key, target, mode, priority, zero-based order, unresolved reference array, last_error and suppressed_errors

api.time.set.reason: Readable authority acknowledgement or original rejection reason

diagnostics.PATCH_READ_ONLY: Unsupported native mutation, observer return value or world-write call from any patch callback
diagnostics.PATCH_VALUES: Invalid typed writer result or time arguments; original request not executed on writer rejection
diagnostics.PATCH_WRITER_CONFLICT: Combined paused/speed slot already has an exclusive owner
diagnostics.PATCH_CYCLE: Ordering cycle; previous published generation retained
diagnostics.PATCH_REFERENCE_TARGET: Ordering reference points to another target
diagnostics.PATCH_AUTHORITY_UNKNOWN: No acknowledged session authority; mutation not executed
diagnostics.PATCH_AUTHORITY_DENIED: Session authority denied the operation; mutation not executed

lifecycle.lua_reload: Replace the owner's complete set after candidate validation and activation; rejected candidate retains the old Lua instance and order
lifecycle.world_changes: Reload does not undo confirmed changes or replay unknown actions
lifecycle.callback_failure: Lua runtime callback errors disable only the owning mod and retain the original cause; other owners continue and native original observation remains once
lifecycle.initial_authority_denial: No Before or After is entered
lifecycle.time_after: Confirmed adapter return: original_returned true, outcome confirmed and result. Writer rejection or authority change after Before: original_returned false, outcome rejected. Adapter exception: original_returned false, outcome unknown. A failed Before does not enter its own After.
